items.title: 2026 Porsche Esports Supercup World Championship Series | Race #1 | Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps | Preview
items.summary: 32 regional graduates — including Job, Pinto, Webster, and 19 world-championship rookies — head to Spa, with live coverage Saturday at 19:00 GMT on Porsche’s YouTube and Twitch.

items.title: Quentin Warman plays postseason spoiler, earns first-career eNASCAR Coca-Cola iRacing Championship Series win at Texas
items.summary: Warman three-wides Steven Wilson and Seth DeMerchant in overtime at Texas Motor Speedway for a first career eNASCAR win, with three Championship 4 tickets still open.

items.title: Start Your Engines! NASCAR 26 Launches Today on PC, PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S
items.summary: iRacing Studios and NASCAR open Gold Edition early access for NASCAR 26 on consoles and Steam, with Standard Edition following September 18.

items.title: 2026 Season 4 Hotfix 1 Release Notes [2026.09.11.01]
items.summary: Official patch: Caterham 420R and Academy rear-axle damage so cars can leave pit stalls, plus crashes when minimizing the sim or using replay VCR controls.

items.title: iRacing hotfix to “fundamentally improve” Caterham handling
items.summary: Thomas Harrison-Lord on the day-after Caterham pass: rear axles that ‘translate fully,’ better handling on both models, and the pit-lane stuck-car bug.

items.title: iRacing’s AI Racing Adds Eight Cars, 19 Track Configurations for 2026 Season 4
items.summary: Valkyrie AMR-LMH, both Caterhams, and Gen 4 Grand National launch AI-ready, plus Daytona Prototypes, Formula Renault 2.0, and new scans at Road America, Mid-Ohio, and Milwaukee.

items.title: iRacing Season 4 2026 released with key track updates, UI changes and car upgrades
items.summary: Traxion’s desk recap of the September 9 build: laser-scans, Road America East/West, Milwaukee roval, MX-5 overhaul, Pit Summary widget, and multiclass pace cars.

items.title: iRacing 2026 Season 4 is live
items.summary: Official Season 4 feature page: four new cars, multi-threaded physics, Minimal UI Mode, F9 Quick Access, Fuel Calculator, and rain-enabled Valkyrie and Caterhams.

items.title: All iRacing content will be available in career mode at ‘zero extra cost’
items.summary: Greg Hill says the in-progress single-player career will unlock the full car and track pool inside career without extra purchases — still without a ship date.

items.title: iRacing Development Update: August 2026
items.summary: Season 4 preview from the production team: Gen 4 Grand National, rebuilt pavement Sprint Car, multi-threaded physics milestone, and a soft launch of multi-class pace cars.
